name: Rue des Gestes — Rue de la Mise-en-Place · fourrer, devancer, se positionner
note: Tiered verb place; all six verbs are -er, so they all live on the LEFT cottages (the right side is a low stone wall with hedges, no verbs). Tiers: street (woman stuffing a fur coat into a tiny suitcase, soldier setting down his kitbag at his billet door beside a framed mirror, cyclist overtaking the blue van), balcony (man counting coins into the shopkeeper's hand to settle up), upper (man placing a cherry in the centre of a cake), roof (goalkeeper positioning himself in front of the goal, mirror propped beside it). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
